messages:
sarah_ae: FYI — Tellus sent a rather detailed RFI. They want a short POC (2 weeks) + capability matrix and answers for security + pricing. Can we triage?

mike_solutions: I can take the capability matrix. Need their target throughput/latency and whether they want embeddings + chat gen in the same test. Any specifics in the RFI?

sarah_ae: They listed two workloads: embeddings at ~2000/sec peak (batched) and conversational generation ~30 req/s multi-turn. They flagged 'quantization impact on accuracy' and asked about HSM/KMS for on-prem. RFI due Friday.

anya_product: Short notes on quantization: we have tested int8 and int4 profiles for our curated models. Typical quality delta: ~1-5% depending on eval suite. Important: recommend running their evalset against quantized model in POC to validate. I'll attach quant-profiles doc.

devon_security: They also sent a security questionnaire (attachment). Key asks: customer-managed keys, HSM for on-prem, audit log retention (1 year), SOC2, and data residency controls. We support CMK via KMS integrations and HSM in Private with our on-prem appliance. Need legal for FedRAMP comments.

raj_sre: For Dedicated throughput/perf numbers I'll pull p50/p95 from our perf bench for the requested model variants. Quick note: batching + prefix cache will help embed qps a lot. For gen, KV cache and token-parallelism matter.

mike_solutions: Action plan: I'll draft a capability matrix (columns: feature, hosted, dedicated, private, notes) and include perf rows: embeddings qps (batched), gen p50/p95, steady-state tokens/sec, cold-start. Also add quantization row with recommended eval step.

sarah_ae: Pricing ask: they want reserved capacity pricing for Dedicated (24/7 4-GPU baseline) and a POC uplift for 2 weeks. Can we get a ballpark to put in RFI?

raj_sre: Ballpark (for internal use): 4x A100-equivalent reserved pool ~ mid-five-figures/month for infra, plus managed platform fee. POC short-term uplift typically as one-off dev credits or short-term reserved @ slightly higher rate. I'll prepare a simple table.

devon_security: Quick blocker flag: Tellus said they may require FedRAMP moderate. We don't have FedRAMP yet. If it's mandatory for their procurement, we need to call that out; otherwise proceed with compensating controls for POC.

anya_product: Noted. Also include a sample POC config snippet in the response so they know what we'll deploy:```
deployment:
  mode: private-vpc
  gpus: 4
  quant_profile: int8
  cache: prefix
```

mike_solutions: I'll upload the matrix + perf numbers to the shared drive and link here. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Will also attach a short README with test harness instructions.

sarah_ae: Thanks — sending the RFI + questionnaire to the thread now: <https://drive.redwood/tellus-rfi-2026.pdf>. Please ping when you add answers.

ops_bot: New file uploaded: tellus-capability-matrix-draft.xlsx by mike_solutions

mike_solutions: Uploaded draft and perf CSV. Link: <https://drive.redwood/tellus-cap-matrix-draft>. Please review.

sarah_ae: Reviewing now. If we can get security answers + pricing table by tomorrow noon I can submit the RFI. :thumbsup:

anya_product: I'll review quant guidance and add a short paragraph recommending A/B eval against their metric set.

devon_security: I'll fill security questionnaire answers and highlight the HSM flow for Private deployments. If legal needs to weigh in on FedRAMP we should loop them ASAP.

mike_solutions: Noted. Will add explicit perf caveats (sequence length, batch shape) and a recommended test plan for the 2-week POC.

sarah_ae: Great teamwork — I'll chase legal for FedRAMP guidance and update procurement timeline after their reply.
